interface.longDescription: David.md packages practical, inspectable agent workflows for Codex. Its first skill, Fable Advisor, runs Claude Fable through the local Claude Code harness as a verified read-only planning and review advisor. It gives Fable broad access to repository search, web research, read-only shell commands, and explicitly approved read tools while blocking side effects.
